primary_citations.title: Molecular data needs for advanced collisional-radiative modelling for hydrogen plasmas
primary_citations.scope: Distinguishes electronic CR, Fulcher rovibrational corona and ground-state vibrational CR models. Describes a990-sublevel Fulcher model in this version and discusses selected Lyman/Werner corona models. It explicitly distinguishes corona approximations from a complete rovibrational CR model.

primary_citations.title: A fully ro-vibrationally resolved corona model for the molecular hydrogen Fulcher-α system
primary_citations.journal: Journal of Quantitative Spectroscopy and Radiative Transfer338,109414
primary_citations.scope: Yacora-based H2Fulcher-α corona model with1365rovibrational levels in X,d,a and45260MCCC electron-impact excitation cross sections. Entire Fulcher spectra are produced by postprocessing. Benchmark is low-pressure inductively coupled hydrogen plasma; the paper examines limits of the corona approximation.
primary_citations.observable_limit: Fulcher-α is a visible molecular band. This model is not by itself a rotationally resolved115–165nm Lyman/Werner model or a water-fragment-network model.

primary_citations.title: The plasma physicist’s guide to CR modelling based on the Yacora solver for atomic and molecular hydrogen
primary_citations.scope: Separates YacoraH,YacoraH2,YacoraH2(X1,v),YacoraH2(v),andYacoraH2(v,N)Fulcher. Use the explicit variant and its reaction data when defining a comparison, rather than treating Yacora as a single resolution-independent implementation.
